lines.english: I feel the life, and I craft it
I play a Song for your sake
I entwine my heart into the strumming harp
So its sound won't be interrupted no matter how soft it is
Riding in the wind, riding in this Song, until it reaches you

lines.hymmnos: (Whispers)
lines.english: Little by little, doing it over and over, I'll craft my repeating feelings,
Don't be afraid, don't suffer, believe in the people, don't suffer alone, don't be sad, and feel the gentle love
To convey the warmth of my life

lines.hymmnos: (Whispers)
lines.english: To convey the warmth of the life
Believe in the people, don't suffer alone, don't be sad, and feel the gentle love
You are suffering.
You are suggesting to yourself that you hate that person

lines.hymmnos: En zash yor.
lines.english: And that is causing you pain, right?
It makes you feel impatient
You turned your eyes away from the hometown that'll never return
Just abandoning things if you can't obtain them
When everyone gets lost, they only end up seeing shadows
When everyone gets lost, they only see shadows
Standing still without even knowing what color the world is
Standing still as if they didn't even know what color the world is
At least
So at least I won't forget the wishes, I carve them somewhere, and then
Even if I can't grasp the formless things, they surely exist here
I'll gladly protect you

lines.hymmnos: na gauzewiga... na crudea... crannidale diasee...
lines.english: I'll give you life
So you won't lose your dreams, make sure to treasure them

lines.hymmnos: Was yea ra grandus yor.
lines.english: I'll listen carefully, close my eyes, and believe in you
I'll give (you life)
Don't be afraid... throw suffering away... believe in the people...
Joining your body with the transparent singing voice,
I'll cover your wounds, no matter how small they may be
Both happiness and sadness go to you
Going through the morning, going through the night, I'll craft my feelings,
I want to convey the kindness of the life
For the sake of conveying the kindness of life
You and me
We're being connected by that song...
You listen to your own voice
So at least I won't forget about the bonds, I carve them somewhere, and then
The shapeless things don't remain, but they don't fade away either
So you can protect your dreams, make sure to treasure them
I want to sing here with you, always
Please
So at least I won't forget the feelings, I carve them somewhere, and then
Because I can convey it to you, even if I can't touch you
I'll be glad if I can protect you
I'll protect you
So you won't lose your love, let's make it resound while treasuring it
Sketch a song with me and let's play it in a peaceful voice
Don't be sad, and feel the gentle love
I play a song for my sake

lines.japanese: 戦い続けるあなたの心を 私の愛の光で護りたい 堅く結ばれた ふたりの宿命を 奏でた声が造り出した力
風が吹き抜け 繋がれた手の温かさに 私の生きる証を見つけたの
あなたのひたむきさが 私に強さを与えてく
心を通わせ立ち続けるために 神々よ、我に 護る力委ねよ
貴方の中に見つけた安息が 私の想いを護り続けてる
穢れを知らず 偽りの無いあなただけが 私の胸を明るく照らしだす
あなたが持つ力と 重なる波動 輝いてく

闇に立ち向かう鋼となる力 神々よ、我に その光与えよ
そうすれば貴方はずっと私と分かち合える

lines.english: I'll become my singing...
I'll execute the Luminous Defence for you.
By putting in my greatest feelings, I'll protect you
With the light of my love, I wish to protect your heart that keeps on fighting
Having sung our tightly entwined fates, my voice has produced power
In the warmth of our joined hands, as the wind blows through, I have found something to prove I'm alive
I'll enshroud you with the light of my gentle heart
Your sincerity gives me strength

lines.hymmnos: hymme yor sos pirtue inferiare fandel yanyaue.
lines.english: The warmth of the love crafted by my spirit is extremely precious
I'll become a guardian for you
The peace I have found within you will continue protecting my feelings
Not knowing the taint and never lying, you are the only one that brightly illuminates my heart
The warmth of the love crafted by my spirit is extremely precious

lines.hymmnos: grandee sos yor.
lines.english: The waves joining with the power you bear are shining
Oh Gods, bring us that light! The power that will become the steel that faces off against the darkness!
May the motherly power be there for us
May the power of love be there for us both
I'll accept the shining sincerity in my whole self. That is what I believe in. That is love itself
The warmth of the love crafted by my spirit is extremely precious. That is love itself
Oh Gods, may the light of triumph shine upon us! For all the scars carved at the end of the battles!
So our hearts may keep communicating and we may continue standing... Oh Gods, bestow protective power upon me!
If I do so, you'll always share everything with me

word_glosses.meaning_en: (daylight) shines, shine down brilliantly (Note: However, the phrase "Sol Ciel" refers to the region of the first Ar tonelico tower, and was to be used as the name of the world. It's because there was already a phrase in Central Standard Note for this world, "Ar Ciel", that "Sol Ciel" ended becoming only the name of the region of the first tower. That region owes its name to the Ancient Metafalss Note.)
word_glosses.meaning_jp: （日の光が）輝く、燦々と照りつける (ただし、sol cielという熟語でこの世界「ソル・シエール」を指す。ただし標準律では世界を指すときに「ar ciel」といい、「sol ciel」とは言わない。この世界をsol cielと言うのはあくまで古メタファルス律のみ。)

lines.english: Forgetting its wounds, the time reawakens and resumes its cycling
Groups of people come and go through the city
Children run throughout the alleys
I seal the incarnation of the wriggling lust deep within the darkness
I weave the months and days into a melody, I strum the strings of time to play it
I'll carry alone every bit of suffering in this world as I wander about
Praying at night, wishing at morning

lines.hymmnos: Kusamura haneru mushitachi yuuzora akazaru hoshiboshi
lines.english: The bugs jump from the thickets, becoming stars adorning the night sky
This isn't an event to be sad about. I'll be with the Gods forever
The sin vanishes far at the distance, everyone keeps walking without ever mentioning it
Vividly, the sprouting plants become new, small lives
Today's stocks adorn the shops
Always... Always...
The light in the windows of the house that awaits your safe return
Awaits your safe... return...
Exposing my bare body to the scorching heat, I roam about through land and Heavens
The moons wax and wane as if they pulsated, the seasons cycle as if they breathed
I'll sacrifice myself as atonement for every fault committed in this world
May glory be bestowed upon the Heavens, may abundance be bestowed upon the land
I step onto and purify the rubble, the rut of foul conflicts

lines.english: The days I walked alone were something natural to me
In such a way I lived so I wouldn't destroy my own enclosed world
The mirror reflects a fake smile
Opposite to the clouds inside my heart
Many people wandering under the sky
To protect myself from them, I lived a life locked within myself
The happiness that me has come to know now
Is something I'll reach if I reach out with my arms
It's just at the other side of the gate, I don't need to overdo it
Let us talk with truthful words
Thus, to this world, and to the people I meet
I'll give them the Song of love that tied the flowers together
If I share my happiness with someone precious
My enclosed world will extend further before I notice
The eyes will reflect a sincere smile
If I open my heart
Many people with thousands of feelings
I want to embrace the radiance in their eyes with my hands
I will never be the only special one here
And everyone certainly feels the same way
It's just at this side of the gate, I don't need to overdo it
And we can understand each other with truthful words
Thus, with this world, with the people I meet

lines.english: I'll summon you to this place
Oh Song, descend upon me
Oh Song, please dwell inside my heart
And then, you'll become a Song
As an apostle, my voice
will express these feelings
In the waves crossing the time and reaching the ground

lines.english: They all are what Songs are
Until the body I was given dies away
I always think that Songs are mysterious
That Songs shake the bottom of my heart more than anything
I'll pluck and make resound my heartstrings to craft the magic of happiness
My voice rides on the wind
And radiantly becomes the seed of hope
The future sprouting within countless hearts
Sing like the little birds, sing like the little streams
is a shapeless eternal flower you sketched
I'll become something good for everyone, and then I'll become a flower
I will keep singing, today and tomorrow
Blessing your future, I'll send you back to your world of origin
They all are what Songs are

固く結んだ手 時には抗うけれど

lines.hymmnos: kanadeau tabi ni sukoshidzutsu chikakunareru
lines.japanese: 伝える気持ちに 飾りは何もいらない
寂しげな背中 迷いに震えてた

lines.hymmnos: sabishigena senaka mayoi ni furueteta
lines.japanese: 握り締めた手に 想いをにじませて
けれど信じて続けて

lines.hymmnos: keredo shinjitsudzukete
lines.japanese: 一人じゃないよと 今すぐ伝えたい
重ねあうたびに ぬくもりは伝わるもの
交わしあう言葉 時には冷たいけれど

lines.hymmnos: kasaneau tabi ni nukumori wa tsutawarumono
lines.japanese: 偽りを捨てて いつまでもそばにいたい

word_glosses.meaning_jp: どちらでもない 今、有るがままの状況を受け入れる（第Ⅲ想音）

lines.japanese: 偽りを捨てて いつまでもそばにいたい

lines.english: Our feelings are in disagreement, as you walk without
Even turning back while I stop on my tracks.
However, I don't want to continue my travel alone by any means

lines.hymmnos: However, I don't want to continue my travel alone by any means
lines.english: Let's let our joining bonds cross over the opening door

lines.hymmnos: tsutaeru kimochi ni kazari wa nanimo iranai
lines.english: The more we play a song together, little by little, the more I'll get closer

word_glosses.meaning_jp: どちらでもない 今、有るがままの状況を受け入れる（第Ⅲ想音）

lines.english: To you, my important and irreplaceable person
Although our strongly joined hands will quarrel against each other sometimes,
The feelings we convey to each other don't need any embellishments

lines.hymmnos: nigirishimeta te ni omoi o nijimasete
lines.english: Confused, you trembled as you faced away from me lonesomely,
But when I grasped firmly your hands, our feelings began to blur into each other
However, I'll continue believing

lines.hymmnos: However, I'll continue believing
lines.english: That kindness will turn into strength
You're not alone! That's what I want to tell you right now

lines.hymmnos: itsuwari o sutete itsumademo soba ni itai
lines.english: The more we join our feelings, the more warmth I'll convey
Although the words we exchange may at times be cold,
I just want to always be at your side, without any lies between us.
The more we play a song together, little by little, the more I'll get closer

katakumusunda te toki ni wa aragau keredo

kawashiau kotoba toki ni wa tsumetai keredo
